title: SG-10.2.3 Remove store-driven focus and unsubscribe on scene shutdown
summary: On BootScene shutdown, clear scene and store focus and release the store subscription, covered by a unit test.
description: Context: BootScene.create registers a SHUTDOWN handler (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) that removes the keydown listener, unsubscribes from useGameStore, and destroys effects, scene objects and characters. It does not blur focused objects or reset gameStore.focusedObjectId. Desired behavior: on shutdown the focus is removed and the subscription is released. Expected result: after shutdown no scene object stays focused, the store focusedObjectId is null, and later store changes do not reach the scene. Why: a stale focus id would re-highlight objects when the scene restarts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a focused object, when the scene shuts down, then the object is blurred and focusedObjectId is null.
Given the scene has shut down, when the store changes, then onStateChange is not invoked and no object is focused.
A unit test asserts both behaviors.

in_scope: Unit test for shutdown focus removal
preserve: Existing shutdown cleanup of keyboard listener, effects, objects and characters

technical_constraints: Unit tests mock Phaser as in tests/bootSceneFocusClear.test.ts
